cron.label.expr: Cron expression — minute hour day month weekday
cron.status.idle: Standard 5-field cron. Times are worked out in this device’s time zone.
cron.err.fields: It needs 5 fields — minute hour day month weekday. (Aliases like @daily and @hourly work too.)
cron.err.parse: One of the fields cannot be read. Only numbers, *, ranges (1-5), steps (*/10), lists (1,3) and names (MON, JAN) work.
cron.list.never: It never runs in the next two years (e.g. February 30th).
